recipe.build:
sed -r '/    signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d ; s/signingConfigs\[.*\]/null/' -i app/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleFossRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/eu.darken.myperm-*-FOSS-RELEASE-*apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
